Paragraph: Hanuma when said thus virtuous Lakshmana adored him customarily in the way befitting to an envoy, and spoke this to Rama...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Acknowledging Hanuman's reassurance with proper protocol.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Lakshmana honors Hanuman and turns to share the good news with Rama.
Outcome/Resolution: Positive reinforcement of the diplomatic breakthrough.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Gratitude and restoration of calm spirits

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Adara (respectful acknowledgment of a messenger's service)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Demonstrating adara, profound respect for a skilled and compassionate envoy.
